environment.config: canonical C0 V2 measurement-track config with v_s=0 and defender_standby_until_detection=False
environment.curriculum_scaffold: hold-until-detection is a curriculum simplification (isolates evasion of a moving interceptor from the pre-contact escort transient); NOT the final defender benchmark; later stages must remove it
environment.defender: canonical scripted `greedy` controller, unmodified; HELD fixed (zero velocity/acceleration, Greedy action not applied) until canonical detection (`env._enemy_detected`: true 3-D attacker-defender distance <= detection_radius, sticky); the step in which detection becomes true is still held (canonical standby ordering); from the next step the unmodified Greedy action drives the unmodified constrained dynamics (18 m/s, 8 m/s^2, 90 deg/s) with canonical swept interception 2.5 m; never returns to hold
environment.defender_observation: canonical 25 m true-range gate (flag, position, velocity features); release flag / release time / lambda / nominal path are NOT observed
environment.placement: Stage2-v2 nominal-A0-path placement (a1_cur2_static_defender_nominal_path_v1): lam ~ U(0.35,0.65), r ~ U(0,1.5 m), never resampled to force an outcome

hypothesis: A policy that has learned static-threat evasion can transfer that behavior to a moving scripted interceptor while preserving its expert-initialized pursuit capability.

initialization.actor_critic_log_std: policy state_dict of the matching Stage2-v2 rollout-16 model (actor, CRITIC and log_std preserved: observation / reward / value semantics unchanged)
initialization.optimizer: RESET (fresh Adam from PPO construction) at the curriculum boundary

mastery: two consecutive rollout validations pass ALL gate checks
observation_audit: keep 37-D: the defender is invisible (zero features) outside the 25 m gate and stationary until released, the release (15 m detection) happens while it is already inside the gate, and its onset is then inferable from the observed defender velocity feature; the only unobservable quantity is the defender's pre-release dwell, which carries no information the attacker could use

parents.note: Stage2-v2 did NOT satisfy its frozen mastery rule (0/3); the rollout-16 checkpoints are PROVISIONAL CURRICULUM INITIALIZATION CHECKPOINTS after manual inspection, not accepted/final A1 models

scenario_validation_rule.validity: no immediate-contact degeneracy (no episode ending within 1 step of reset, defender initial distance > detection radius, every intercepted episode gave the policy >= 2 decisions with the defender inside the 25 m gate), defender velocity at release = 0, defender fixed before release, Greedy takes over after release, no invalid state

single_conceptual_change_from_stage3_v1: Defender motion is suppressed before canonical detection; after detection, the existing Greedy controller is released unchanged.

stage3_v1.outputs_never_mixed: separate results / scratch / docs namespaces; verify_rollout rejects any manifest with a different protocol sha
stage3_v1.verdict: STOPPED at scenario validation: A0 interception 0/1000 (escort transient)

success_rule: >= 2/3 seeds master, mastered seeds retain Stage-1 pursuit and static-defender evasion, no shared structural pathology
tests: moving-adversary complexity only (asset stationary, C0, no obstacles, no defender-policy diversity)

validation.alternation: rollout k: odd -> A, even -> B
validation.final: 154000-154199 (200 episodes) + matched canonical A0 + Stage2-v2 parent

namespace_overlaps.rejected_suggestion_149000_149199: overlaps Stage-2 placement-validation 149000-149999 (evaluation only); fresh block used
